name: CMOS RF IC Design
description: Historical aspects – from Maxwell to current wireless standards; the bridge between communication system designer and RF IC designer: a) communication system characterization, b) RF system characterization; transceiver architectures – motivation for the individual blocks; lumped, passive RLC, RF properties of MOS, tuned amplifiers; LNAs: noise sources, cascades and LNA design; mixers – passive and active mixers; power amplifiers; oscillators: analysis fundamentals, inductors, basics of LC oscillators and VCOs; basics of phase locked loops.
